resume_text: Delivered an internal HR FAQ assistant for ~300 employees. Standard RAG stack: chunk the policy PDFs, embed them, store in a vector DB, retrieve top-k, answer with an LLM, show citations. Followed the vendor reference architecture closely. Added an 'I don't know, ask HR' fallback when retrieval confidence is low. Shipped in 6 weeks, still in use, ~200 queries/week, owned it end to end including rollout and support. Reliable and on time. I tend to reach for the proven pattern rather than reinvent things.
